method: Original lossless decoded frames. 16 angular sectors from -pi, counterclockwise; median top 5 percent luminance in radius .35-.56, sector half-width pi/24. Glow uses the top 10 percent chromatic scores above 75 percent of sector peak luminance: R-G for pink sectors, min(G,B)-R for cyan sectors, luminance for neutral sectors. Four interior disk samples at (+/- .18,+/- .18), radius .035. Source half-height coordinates. Samples include optical composition; they are not proprietary shader colors.
